design.thesis: Documents and Interlace as frontispiece artifacts: fourteen mutually distinct engraved plates in one burin hand — clinical chart, taxi letterbox, dusk horizon, fatigue curve, night dorm, autumn walk, night globe, hard-cut triptych, split phone, pulley elevation, dialectic bays, tabloid, dossier card, treatise-broadside. Voice shifts marked by hard cuts, never blends; neighboring chapters rhyme in grammar (desert diptych shares horizon geometry; ETA day/night share tile; envoy closers share cadence) without cloning composition.
